why: Building-group copy silently omitted internal utility connections and inherited equipment wear; moving connected groups left paths at old coordinates and could fail native placement validation.
change: Copy discovers routes whose endpoints belong to selected buildings or included pumps, allocates separate route identities, remaps pump cables and equipment ownership, translates paths and retains authored condition. Group movement translates internal paths. Connections to outside owners, standalone battery banks and the shared truck are not duplicated. Building-embedded battery configuration already travels with its building.
checks: Native-valid connected copy and move; partial selection excludes external connections while retaining its own pump; truck is not copied; reverse route order and matching building/route text IDs remain distinct; identity collision rejection; exact atomic undo/redo. Browser uses trusted Shift-marquee on nine buildings, Copy group placement, Move group drag, native readiness, exact undo/redo/reload and original-owner preservation, with no page errors and completed cleanup.
visual_review: Individually inspected copied-quarter.png and moved-quarter.png. Original and copied quarter are distinct in the copy capture; movement leaves one quarter at the new location with its visible internal pipes. Inspector explanation is readable.
limits: Controlled nine-building quarter, not maximum-group throughput or a difficulty-balanced scenario. External routes remain authored and may need explicit repair before a move can pass validation. Goal regions and journal references remain unchanged; copying buildings does not duplicate the story.
